questions.question: Rs. 43,120 is divided among P, Q and R such that P's share is 4/7 of total share of Q and R together and Q's share is 2/5 of total share of P and R together. What is the share of R?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Total amount = Rs. 43,120,

P's share is 4/7 of total share of Q and R together.

Q's share is 2/5 of total share of P and R together.

**Concept Used:**

Ratio and proportion method for distribution

**Calculation:**

P/(Q + R) = 4/7 .............(i)

Q/(P + R) = 2/5 .............(ii)

Make the sum of numerator and denominator equal in both equation by multiply (i) by 7 and (ii) by 11.

P/(Q + R) = 28/49 

Q/(P + R) = 22/55

⇒ P : Q : R = 28 : 22 : 27

⇒ Total parts = 28 + 22 + 27 = 77

⇒ Share of R = (27/77) × Rs. 43,120 = Rs. 15120

**Therefore, R's share is Rs. 15120.**

questions.question: A trapezium plate has two parallel sides of length 15 cm and 9 cm, and the distance between them is 6 cm. Copper plating is to be done on the plate at a rate of Rs. 3 per square cm. What will be the total cost of copper plating on the upper side of the plate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A trapezium plate has two parallel sides of length 15 cm and 9 cm, and the distance between them is 6 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = 1/2 × (sum of lengths of parallel sides) × (distance between the parallel sides)

**Calculation:**

Area = 1/2 × (15 cm + 9 cm) × 6 cm = 72 square cm

If the cost of copper plating is Rs. 3 per square cm, then the total cost of copper plating for 72 square cm will be:

Cost = 72 sq.cm × Rs. 3/sq.cm = Rs. 216

**So, the total cost of copper plating on the upper side of the plate would be Rs. 216.**

questions.question: A man spends Rs. 2,300 monthly on average for the first four months and Rs. 1,800 monthly for the next eight months and saves Rs. 12,400 a year. Find his monthly income.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average monthly expenditure for the first 4 months = Rs. 2,300,

Average monthly expenditure for the next 8 months = Rs. 1,800, Annual savings = Rs. 12,400

**Solution:**

Total expenditure for the first 4 months = 4 × 2,300 = Rs. 9,200

Total expenditure for the next 8 months = 8 × 1,800 = Rs. 14,400

Total expenditure for the year = 9,200 + 14,400 = Rs. 23,600

Monthly income = Total expenditure + Annual savings / 12

Monthly income = 23,600 + 12,400 / 12

Monthly income = 36,000 / 12

**Monthly income = Rs. 3,000**

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Count the total number of given values, which is 11 (an odd number).

The median position is exactly the middle term: (11 + 1) ÷ 2 = 6th position.

To save time, we do not need to sort all numbers. Just identify the 6 smallest values mentally.

The 6 smallest terms in ascending order are: 16, 50, 55, 57, 60, and 69.

The 6th term is 69, which is our required median.

**∴ The correct answer is 69.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 57, 96, 60, 91, 69, 50, 72, 16, 78, 73, 55

Total number of terms (n) = 11

**Formula Used:**

Median (for an odd number of terms) = Value of the ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term in the sorted data set.

 Finding the Median

 (6th term out of 11)

⇒ First, arrange the data set in ascending order:

⇒ Number of terms (n) = 11 (which is odd)

⇒ Median position = (11 + 1) ÷ 2 = 12 ÷ 2 = 6th position

questions.question: If 6 # 2 = 4, 2 # 6 = 4 and 14 # 12 = 13, then find the value of 4 # 24 = ?

**Solution:**

sin θ + cos θ = √2 ⇒ √2 (sin θ + cos θ) = 2

Multiply √2 inside the brackets ⇒ sin θ √2 + cos θ √2 = 2

⇒ cosec θ + cot θ = √2 + 1

**Therefore, the value of cosec θ + cot θ is √2 + 1.**

questions.question: Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 60 kmph and including stoppages, it is 54 kmph. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?

• In a **double displacement reaction**, the anions and cations of two different molecules switch places, forming two entirely different compounds.
 
• **Redox reactions** are essential for various biological processes and industrial applications, including energy production, corrosion, and the synthesis of materials.

questions.question: What will happen when a plant cell is put in a medium having higher water concentration than the cell?

options.text: It will not show any change

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When a **plant cell** is placed in a medium with higher water concentration (hypotonic solution) than the cell, water enters the cell due to **osmosis**.
 
• **Osmosis** is the movement of water molecules from a region of higher water potential to a region of lower water potential through a **semi-permeable membrane**.
 
• Plant cells have a **rigid cell wall** that prevents them from bursting under osmotic pressure.
 
• The entry of water into the cell causes the **vacuole** to expand, pushing the cell membrane against the cell wall, leading to the cell swelling.
 
• The pressure exerted by the swollen vacuole against the cell wall is called **turgor pressure**, which helps maintain the shape and rigidity of the cell.
 
• This swelling is critical for the plant's **structural integrity and physiological processes**, such as nutrient transport and photosynthesis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **It will not show any change**__

 __
 
• This would occur if the plant cell was placed in an **isotonic solution**, where the concentration of water is the same inside and outside the cell.
 
• No net movement of water occurs, and the cell remains unchanged.
 
 
 
• **It will likely shrink**__
 __
 
• This happens when the plant cell is placed in a **hypertonic solution**, where the water concentration outside the cell is lower than inside.
 
• Water moves out of the cell, causing the cell to lose turgor pressure and shrink, a process known as **plasmolysis**.
 
 
 
• **It will burst**__
 
 
• Plant cells do not burst due to the presence of a **rigid cell wall**, which can withstand high internal pressure.
 
• This option is applicable to **animal cells**, which lack a cell wall and may burst in a hypotonic solution.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about a colloidal solution is INCORRECT?

options.text: Colloidal solutions are a heterogeneous mixture.
Components cannot be separated by the process of filtration.
Fog is an example of a colloidal solution.
Milk is not a colloidal solution.

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Milk is not a colloidal solution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milk** is, in fact, a **colloidal solution**, not a non-colloidal solution as mentioned in the question.
 
• A colloidal solution is a **heterogeneous mixture** where one substance is dispersed evenly throughout another.
 
• In milk, fat globules are dispersed in water, making it an example of an **emulsion**, which is a type of colloidal solution.
 
• The particles in colloidal solutions, such as milk, are so small that they do not settle down and cannot be separated by ordinary filtration methods.
 
• Milk exhibits the **Tyndall effect**, which is a characteristic property of colloids, where light is scattered by the dispersed particles.
 
• Examples of colloidal solutions like milk are common in daily life and include substances such as **fog, whipped cream, and jelly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Colloidal solutions are a heterogeneous mixture**__

 __
 
• A **heterogeneous mixture** is one where the composition is not uniform throughout the solution.
 
• In a colloidal solution, the dispersed phase (small particles) and the dispersion medium (substance in which particles are dispersed) remain separate, making it heterogeneous.
 
• Examples of colloidal solutions include **fog, smoke, and milk.**
 
 
 
• **Components cannot be separated by the process of filtration**__
 __
 
• The particles in a colloidal solution are very small, typically in the range of **1-1000 nanometers**.
 
• Due to their small size, they pass through ordinary filter paper, and hence, **filtration cannot separate them.**
 
• Specialized methods like **ultrafiltration** are required to separate colloidal particles.
 
 
 
• **Fog is an example of a colloidal solution**__
 
 
• Fog is an example of an **aerosol**, which is a type of colloidal solution where tiny liquid droplets are dispersed in air.
 
• The particles in fog scatter light, making it another example of the **Tyndall effect**.
 
• This dispersion of water droplets in air is why fog reduces visibility significantly.

The length of this chord is 30 cm.

Formula used:

1. Radius² = (Distance of the chord from the center)² + (Half of the Chord length)²

2. Diameter = Radius × 2

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c2297e01dc0d45d118af8d45e2ed894cfdc372b2e37c2aa593eb24bbfcd4675.png] 

Half of the chord length = 30/2 = 15 cm

Distance of the chord from the center = 20 cm

According to the formula,

Length of the radius = sqrt{20² + 15²} = 25 cm

Now, the length of the diameter = 25 × 2 = 50 cm

∴ The diameter of the circle will be 50 cm.
